response.sql: WITH member_counts AS (SELECT a.link_to_member AS member_id, m.position, COUNT(*) AS attendance_count FROM attendance AS a JOIN member AS m ON m.member_id = a.link_to_member GROUP BY a.link_to_member, m.position) SELECT member_id, position, attendance_count, 1.0 * attendance_count / SUM(attendance_count) OVER () AS share FROM member_counts ORDER BY share DESC LIMIT 10;

assumptions.assumption: At least 10 member id and position combinations have matching attendance records; otherwise the query returns fewer than 10 rows.
